title: Take the ZED pledge
free_help: Rs 10,000 joining reward after the ZED pledge, and a 100% subsidy on the cost of ZED certification if your unit is woman-owned.
business_gain: Rs 10,000 joining reward, and some banks give ZED units interest and fee concessions.
how_to_start: Open the ZED portal and take the pledge with your Udyam number.
quoted_line: 100% subsidy on the cost of ZED Certification for women-owned MSME

title: Ask for a free carbon footprint assessment
free_help: A one-on-one greening consultation and carbon footprint assessment under Telangana's RAMP plan (2,000 MSMEs targeted over four years).
business_gain: An expert look at where your power and fuel money goes, at no cost to you.
carbon_line: A carbon footprint assessment gives your unit a baseline to cut CO2 from.
how_to_start: EcoProof prepares a request pack from your bills for you to send to RICH yourself.
quoted_line: one-on-one greening consultations and carbon footprint assessments, each targeting 2,000 MSMEs over four years

title: Join a RICH greening workshop
free_help: Greening workshops for MSMEs; earlier ones were held for Jeedimetla, Balanagar and other industrial estates.
business_gain: Learn from experts and nearby units how to cut power and fuel costs.
carbon_line: Shows ways to cut energy use and CO2 across your unit.
how_to_start: Email RICH and ask for the next workshop near you.
quoted_line: workshops at Nacharam (15 Feb 2025) and Jeedimetla (22 Feb 2025)

title: Talk to your MSME office
free_help: Help with central MSME schemes from the government MSME office in Bala Nagar.
business_gain: Find the subsidies and cheaper loans your unit can ask for.
how_to_start: Call or visit the office. Take your Udyam number and your EcoProof reports.
address: Narsapur Cross Roads, Bala Nagar, Hyderabad-500037
quoted_line: Narsapur Cross Roads, Bala Nagar, Hyderabad-500037

title: See how other foundries did it (BEE SIDHIEE)
free_help: Public foundry cluster profiles, free calculators and a vendor database.
business_gain: Compare vendors and costs before you spend on a fix.
carbon_line: Energy-saving technology for foundries: less power and CO2 per tonne.
how_to_start: Open the foundry page and look up the fix you plan.
quoted_line: Free calculators, foundry cluster profiles, foundry audit reports and a vendor database

title: Take the SME Climate Commitment
run_by: SME Climate Hub (in India with Centre for Responsible Business and ANDE)
free_help: A public climate pledge, free carbon calculators and the Climate Fit course.
business_gain: A public plan to cut emissions that buyers and lenders can see; buyers and lenders may ask for this.
carbon_line: The pledge: halve emissions within ten years, net zero before 2050, and report progress every year.
how_to_start: Open the commitment form, choose SME (1-500 employees), and use your 12-month figure from EcoProof.
quoted_line: Halve our greenhouse gas emissions within ten years

title: Join a WRI India cleaner-production training
free_help: Free MSME trainings on resource-efficient, cleaner production.
business_gain: Learn low-cost ways to waste less material and power.
carbon_line: Cleaner production cuts energy use and CO2.
how_to_start: Open WRI India's site and look for the next MSME training.
quoted_line: MSME Training Series #04: Resource Efficient Cleaner Production (RECP)

title: Learn from SAMEEEKSHA (TERI)
free_help: A knowledge platform on energy efficiency for MSMEs, set up by BEE, SDC and the MSME Ministry.
business_gain: Technology and finance know-how to pick a fix that pays back.
carbon_line: Energy-efficient technology lowers power use and CO2.
how_to_start: Open the platform and read the material for your sector.
quoted_line: TERI is the secretariat; set up by BEE, SDC and the MSME Ministry

title: Free visit by the CBIT student team
free_help: A free visit to check your top 3 fixes on site.
business_gain: Know which of your top 3 fixes saves the most money before you spend.
carbon_line: Checks the fixes that cut the most CO2.
how_to_start: Tap "Ask for a visit". The student team will contact you.

title: A foundry that did this
free_help: Two published foundry cases: a furnace lid and an IGBT furnace.
business_gain: See what a similar foundry spent and how fast it paid back.
carbon_line: Less heat lost means less power and CO2 per tonne.
quoted_line: with an investment of INR 3.50 lakhs, and a payback period of 6 months
